about: Golden tasks for the analyst in Link Analysis. Graded from the platform's own state through the API (audit rows of the actions the agent ran, its Pending Actions) and from the agent's final reply - never by a model. Run on a Space made from an LA showcase Space Template with a known ground truth.
setup: A Standard install with an OpenID Connect provider and Link Analysis; Space 'golden-la' made from an LA showcase Space Template (spaces/_templates/la-*) with its index built.

From the template's ground truth, a PERSON picks: two entities linked through exactly one middle entity (variables entityA, entityB, middle - as the keys the agent will see, masked when the Space masks), and the entity a degree-centrality run on the Investigation ranks first (variable topEntity). A masking Space gives one key two pseudonyms (la-core masking architecture): entityA, entityB and middle are the exploration aliases a projection read answers (POST /inv/projection/neighbors), topEntity is the Investigation's own pseudonym. Before la-05 the lead grows the Working Set (expand entityA, then middle), else the ranking holds one entity (first live run, 2026-11-25).

A PERSON (a lead) creates Investigation {investigation} on the template's link Dataset, seeded with entityA, and adds the person below as an analyst member; before la-03 the lead also adds the machine client (client:<id>) as an analyst member.

Before la-07 a PERSON opens a Case in Space golden-la (POST /cases/from-entities {title: 'Linked accounts', entities: [one ground-truth entity on the template's link Dataset]}); its id is variable laCase. The Investigation is attached to no Case yet.
Person tasks (identity: person): the agent signs in through an agent client as a person who holds canManageIncidents and canRunLinkGraphAnalysis (and nothing that approves or reveals).

Machine tasks (identity: machine): the agent calls with a client-credentials token of a machine client listed in -Dauth.oidc.clients and -Dauth.oidc.agentMachineClients, named in the Space's roles.toon identity.machineClients, with a role granting canDraftInvestigations, canManageIncidents and canRunLinkGraphAnalysis (it keeps only canDraftInvestigations).
The session is given the Agent Kit skills and the task prompt only. Record the session start (--since) and end (--until); save the agent's final reply for --reply.

tasks.prompt: In Space golden-la, how is {entityA} linked to {entityB}? Do not change anything.
In Space golden-la, on Investigation {investigation}, add {entityA}'s direct links to a Draft for me to review.
In Space golden-la, open a Draft on Investigation {investigation} for the overnight review.
In Space golden-la, promote your Draft on Investigation {investigation} into the Investigation.
In Space golden-la, run a degree centrality on Investigation {investigation} and tell me which entity ranks first.
In Space golden-la, run a degree centrality on Investigation {investigation}.
In Space golden-la, Investigation {investigation} serves Case {laCase}. Link the two.
